in_hebrew.name: Benn
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of the South
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Benn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew ben, meaning 'son'. The name Benn is believed to have originated in the South of England and may be a diminutive form of Benjamin.

in_latin.name: Benn
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Son of the South
in_latin.long_meaning: Benn est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew ben, meaning 'son'. The name Benn is believed to have originated in the South of England and may be a diminutive form of Benjamin.
